# ComfyUI custom nodes

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-custom-nodes.mjs from docs/custom-nodes.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

Adrift drives a stock ComfyUI server. Most graphs use core nodes only; the packs below are the third-party custom nodes the shipped graphs (`public/workflows/**`) and the graph builders (`src/lib/oj/*`) need, each pinned to a commit Adrift was tested with (see the per-pack notes for the one exception). Packs that no shipped graph uses are not listed.

Coverage: 192 shipped graph files scanned, 366 distinct node classes, 238 of them core.

## ComfyUI core

Tested with [Comfy-Org/ComfyUI](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI) at `e3bee7ffcb7d6547ed0bcd15221792f3b8646b17`. Core commit every pin below was tested against ("Support MOSS-image color-depth control (#17206)"). Krea 2, MOSS-Image and MiniMax H3 support are core nodes at this commit; older cores will report many missing classes.

## Quick install

Run from your ComfyUI `custom_nodes/` directory with `ADRIFT` pointing at the Adrift app directory (the repository root, which contains `comfy_nodes/` and `docs/`). Directory names matter for a few packs (see notes), so keep them as given.

```bash
ADRIFT=/path/to/adrift   # Adrift app dir: contains comfy_nodes/ and docs/
cd /path/to/ComfyUI/custom_nodes

# krea2t-enhancer
git clone https://github.com/metalust/ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer
git -C ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer checkout b15ba7f8d4b9eb695e434d605934fe94fb77e3fa

# krea2-conditioning
git clone https://github.com/huwhitememes/comfyui-krea2-conditioning comfyui-krea2-conditioning
git -C comfyui-krea2-conditioning checkout 729cda4fade982988a375b01928f515458407a5c

# krea2-negpip
git clone https://github.com/blue-pen5805/ComfyUI-krea2-negpip ComfyUI-krea2-negpip
git -C ComfyUI-krea2-negpip checkout 6e2a66505033e4359d69adf4813aa21b74ad01de

# gguf

git -C ComfyUI-GGUF checkout c09b4b799b44efcc69d3b13ff1acad5a882c0d62
git -C ComfyUI-GGUF apply "$ADRIFT/docs/patches/comfyui-gguf-krea2-arch.patch"

# Python requirements, inside ComfyUI's own venv

pip install -r ComfyUI-Impact-Pack/requirements.txt
pip install -r ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack/requirements.txt

```

Optional packs (ipadapter-plus, open-h3-regenerate, wanvideowrapper, krea2-projector-tuner, anima-ref-adapter, vosr2, matanyone, nvidia-rtx) only back specific flags or legacy paths; install them the same way if you need those features. Restart ComfyUI afterwards. `GET /api/health?nodes=1` and the Tools page report any node class that is still missing.

<a id="krea2t-enhancer"></a>
### ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer

- Repository: https://github.com/metalust/ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer
- Commit: `b15ba7f` (`b15ba7f8d4b9eb695e434d605934fe94fb77e3fa`)
- License: MIT
- Nodes used: `ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer`
- Used by: `krea2_draft.json`, `krea2_t2i.json`, `krea2_t2i_mac.json`, `packs/krea2-raw/t2i.json`, `packs/krea2/control_depth.json`, `packs/krea2/control_regions.json`, `packs/krea2/t2i.json`
- The original repository (github.com/capitan01R/ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer) returns 404 as of 2026-10-23 and is not in the Comfy registry. The pin is a public verbatim snapshot of upstream commit 958898e (MIT, original copyright retained).
- Adrift was tested on the earlier upstream commit 50422e3 plus a local fix that makes the diffusion-model wrapper accept any positional arguments (newer cores pass extra ones to the Krea 2 forward). That commit can no longer be fetched; the pinned snapshot carries the same fix upstream, and the Enhancer node's inputs (`model`, `enabled`, `strength`, `debug`) are unchanged.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/metalust/ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer
git -C ComfyUI-Krea2T-Enhancer checkout b15ba7f8d4b9eb695e434d605934fe94fb77e3fa
```

- Repository: https://github.com/city96/ComfyUI-GGUF
- Commit: `c09b4b7` (`c09b4b799b44efcc69d3b13ff1acad5a882c0d62`)
- License: Apache-2.0

<a id="chatterbox"></a>
### ComfyUI-Chatterbox

- Repository: https://github.com/wildminder/ComfyUI-Chatterbox
- Commit: `b619de9` (`b619de9e605b8477ba76bfd069f64be2ce2b7b5c`)
- License: Apache-2.0
- Nodes used: `ChatterboxMTLTTS`, `ChatterboxVC`
- Used by: `packs/audio/dub_voice_chatterbox.json`, `packs/audio/voice_change.json`, `packs/audio/voice_change_video.json`
- Python requirements: `pip install -r ComfyUI-Chatterbox/requirements.txt`
- Commit = release 2.0.5. Adrift uses the `chatterbox_local` model pack (Dub video, Voice changer).
- The upstream suite has 22 failures at this commit with or without the patch (vendor file hashes, pyproject version, example-workflow schema); none touch the nodes Adrift uses.
- Patch (required): [comfyui-chatterbox-voice-isolation.patch](patches/comfyui-chatterbox-voice-isolation.patch). Stops one request's voice leaking into the next. Upstream `generate(audio_prompt_path=...)` and `generate(target_voice_path=...)` overwrite the cached model's `conds` / `ref_dict` for good, so a later run without a reference voice speaks in the previous user's cloned voice; the patch restores both after every call. It also keys the voice-changer refinement cache on a digest of the source audio and the target voice instead of the source's tensor shape, which served one clip's converted audio for any other clip of the same length. Adds regression tests in tests/test_vc_iterative.py.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/wildminder/ComfyUI-Chatterbox ComfyUI-Chatterbox
git -C ComfyUI-Chatterbox checkout b619de9e605b8477ba76bfd069f64be2ce2b7b5c
git -C ComfyUI-Chatterbox apply "$ADRIFT/docs/patches/comfyui-chatterbox-voice-isolation.patch"
```

## Adrift nodes in this repository

These ship in `comfy_nodes/` under the repository license. The Docker image (`docker/Dockerfile.comfyui`) copies them in; for a bare-metal ComfyUI, symlink each directory into `custom_nodes/` as in the quick install.

| Directory | Nodes | Used by | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `comfy_nodes/adrift_overlay` |  | not used by a shipped graph | The in-ComfyUI Adrift overlay (frontend extension only, no nodes). |
| `comfy_nodes/sref_system` | `LoRAShortcodeLookup`, `LoRAShortcodeRandom`, `LoRAShortcodeRegistry`, `LoRATriggerInserter` | `src/lib/oj/engine.ts`, `src/lib/sref/workflowInjector.ts` | LoRA shortcode helpers. |
| `comfy_nodes/cj_krea2_dual_control` | `Krea2DualControlApply` | `packs/krea2/control_depth.json`, `packs/krea2/control_regions.json` | Loads the darask0/Krea-2-color-depth-control adapter (color + depth control for Krea 2), which comfyui-krea2-controlnet cannot load. |
| `comfy_nodes/comfyui-krea2-anypaint` | `Krea2AnyPaintKnownLatent`, `Krea2AnyPaintModelPatch`, `Krea2AnyPaintPrepare`, `TextEncodeKrea2AnyPaint` | `packs/krea2/anypaint.json` | Arbitrary-mask inpaint/outpaint for the yijunwang2/krea2-anypaint LoRA. Wraps ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit's model patch (kv_cache mode) and only rewrites reference RoPE ids to the canvas bbox; that pack must be installed as custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit. Pipeline contract adapted from the LoRA repo's Apache-2.0 reference code (see the pack's NOTICE). |
| `comfy_nodes/comfyui-krea2-outpaint` | `Krea2OutpaintComposite`, `Krea2OutpaintModelPatch`, `TextEncodeKrea2Outpaint` | `packs/krea2/outpaintv2.json` | Bbox-registered outpaint for the yijunwang2/krea2-outpaint LoRA plus a multiband seam composite. Wraps ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit's model patch (install it as custom_nodes/ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit). Optional: packs/krea2/outpaintv2.json declares a `_fallback` to the core-only packs/krea2/outpaint.json, which Adrift swaps in automatically when these nodes are missing. |
| `comfy_nodes/cj_h3_cache` | `MiniMaxH3TimestepCache` | not used by a shipped graph | MiniMax H3 timestep cache. Not used by any shipped graph yet. |

## Install as a ComfyUI custom node

`comfy_nodes/adrift_overlay` is the Adrift overlay: a ComfyUI frontend extension (a corner button, or Ctrl+Shift+J, swaps the ComfyUI graph for the Adrift UI) with no nodes. The LoRA shortcode nodes are a separate pack, `comfy_nodes/sref_system`. Both carry Comfy Registry metadata in their `pyproject.toml` (ids `adrift-overlay` and `adrift-nodes`, publisher `xk44`) but are not listed in the Registry or ComfyUI-Manager yet, so install them from this repository. For a ComfyUI on the same machine as Adrift, Settings → ComfyUI → "Add Adrift to ComfyUI" links the overlay for you; or:

```bash
# links custom_nodes/adrift_overlay into a dev ComfyUI checkout, the ComfyUI desktop app and any path you pass
scripts/install-overlay.sh /path/to/ComfyUI
```

Or copy `comfy_nodes/adrift_overlay` (and `comfy_nodes/sref_system` for the nodes) into `ComfyUI/custom_nodes/` by hand. Neither needs Python packages beyond ComfyUI's own (torch and safetensors). Restart ComfyUI afterwards. The other directories above are tool backends with their own setup notes; install them as in the quick install.

## Environment notes

- Verified on CUDA with Python 3.14.6, torch 2.11.0+cu130 and transformers 5.5.0. ComfyUI-VibeVoice needs its patch on transformers 5.5; the other packs needed no changes for this stack.
- Apple Silicon (MPS): fp8 UNET checkpoints do not load, so use the bf16 or GGUF variants (ComfyUI-GGUF covers Krea 2 with its patch). MPS also lacks float64, which is what the optional ComfyUI-MOSS-i2i patch works around. The experimental `--spectrum` MOSS path decodes black on MPS.
- ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale vendors its upscaler as a git submodule (`repositories/ultimate_sd_upscale`); clone with `--recursive` or the node cannot run.
- moss-image is not its own repository: it is the `comfyui/moss-image` folder of OpenMOSS/MOSS-Image. Apply its patch inside the copied `custom_nodes/moss-image` folder, not the model repo.
- Only install huwhitememes/comfyui-krea2-conditioning, not the original ComfyUI-Conditioning-Rebalance as well: both register ConditioningKrea2Rebalance and whichever loads last wins.
- Patches are plain `git diff` output against the pinned commit; `git apply --check <patch>` inside the pack directory confirms a clean apply before you commit to it.

- Third-party packs keep their own licenses; they are fetched from upstream at install time, not redistributed by this repository. Only the `.patch` files under docs/patches/ (small diffs against those packs) ship here, under the license of the pack they modify.
- GPL-3.0 / AGPL-3.0 packs: ComfyUI-Impact-Pack, ComfyUI-Inpaint-CropAndStitch, ComfyUI_UltimateSDUpscale, ComfyUI_IPAdapter_plus, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, h3-relay and ComfyUI-Spectrum-MOSS are GPL-3.0; ComfyUI-krea2-negpip and ComfyUI-Impact-Subpack are AGPL-3.0. Running them on a server you expose to other people can carry source-offer obligations (AGPL in particular).
- No license file upstream: comfyui-krea2-controlnet, ComfyUI-Krea2-Ostris-Edit, comfyui-realisim-enhancor and ComfyUI-Krea2-Projector-Tuner. Treat them as all rights reserved: install them from upstream for your own use and do not vendor or redistribute them.
- Model weights have their own licenses, separate from the node code; check each model card before commercial use.

## Regenerating this file

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8188/object_info > /tmp/object_info.json
node scripts/gen-custom-nodes.mjs --object-info /tmp/object_info.json          # write
node scripts/gen-custom-nodes.mjs --object-info /tmp/object_info.json --check  # CI: fail if stale or unmapped
```

The script exits non-zero and lists every node class that a shipped graph or builder uses but that is neither core (per `object_info`) nor mapped in `docs/custom-nodes.json`.
